superseded_research_statement.statement: The E1 path-hardening delta recorded no current tar/zip extraction implementation in the portable path.
superseded_research_statement.replacement: F2 has release_archive.py with deterministic ZIP authority and the exact nested release ZIP was extracted/compiled/tested in a transient Linux container. The remaining archive/path questions are cross-platform pathname/link semantics and target-host execution, not absence of an archive implementation.

fused_findings.claim: Current release-integrity/WP1110/WP1111 path guards are symlink-oriented but do not centrally reject Windows junctions. CPython >=3.12 provides separate junction detection; the existing G5 hostile-twin executor/tests do not cover junctions. The source-composed prediction is that a Windows directory junction can evade a symlink-only redirect-free invariant.
fused_findings.smallest_discriminator: On Windows CPython >=3.12, create an external-target and root-internal directory junction inside a synthetic package_root, then run build_release_manifest/verify_release_manifest and the WP1110/WP1111 composition. Desired behavior is deterministic explicit rejection before traversal/use.
fused_findings.promotion_rule: Only if reproduced: centralize redirect-free path semantics using stdlib junction+symlink checks before descent/component consumption and reuse them across release_integrity, pre_handoff_release and portable_release_static_completeness.
fused_findings.reason: Stronger race-resistant Linux primitives are unnecessary for the current static portable baseline unless concurrent attacker mutation is formally in scope.

fused_findings.claim: Canonical POSIX manifest/ZIP path syntax does not by itself reject Windows reserved components or case-insensitive materialization collisions.
fused_findings.smallest_discriminator: Run a deterministic scan over the exact 2862-member frozen release ZIP/manifest path set for Windows reserved/trailing-dot-space components and collisions under an explicitly specified Windows portability key.

fused_findings.claim: Lexical check/resolve/path-use sequences are not race-free against concurrent hostile mutation.
fused_findings.smallest_discriminator: Decide whether untrusted concurrent release-root mutation is admitted at the real-host boundary. If excluded, preserve STATIC_SNAPSHOT_ONLY wording. If admitted, use a separate handle-bound verifier and race test; do not relabel path-string checks as race-free.

external_primary_basis: Linux kernel path lookup and openat2 RESOLVE_IN_ROOT/RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS documentation

overlap_analysis.reason: WP1207 G5 exercises bounded filesystem install/update/failure/rollback/readback but no junction-specific tests or is_junction checks were located; the current target route is still pending physical execution after routing repair. The Trigger6 junction lane therefore supplies a new cross-platform falsifier rather than a duplicate executor.

trigger4_handoff.coordination: Do not create a duplicate WP1207 physical dispatch. Existing misrouted run must become terminal or be safely superseded before the already-defined clay-host successor dispatch.
trigger4_handoff.credit_boundary: Repository CI and transient Linux artifact tests do not establish Windows junction behavior, clean-machine target-host execution, physical-host acceptance, effects, completion, GRID/GWT/J-Space, training, or whole-system runtime.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 or a dedicated admitted Windows test lane should run the P0 junction falsifier first; Trigger6 should not implement the fix until reproduction or an equally strong current Windows execution result closes the source-composed prediction.
